name: The Truth of Favours
source:
This is a short Gobblepot fangame in the Gotham TV universe.

Only your actions will determine if Jim is able to maintain a good relationship with Oswald when he visits him to get information about a case.

Will Jim be able to open up about his feelings? Will he and Oswald share a passionate night together?

It's in your hands! 

[From [url=https://genmitsu.itch.io/the-truth-of-favours]itch.io[/url]]
